text_block_list.text:
The third match of the Aoharu Cup 
preseason! In the waiting room, Haru Urara 
was brimming with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Today! I feel like I can win!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because everyone worked so hard, and 
we all became super duper close friends!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So, somehow, I feel like I can win!
